property_summary: For any callee address that implements transferFrom(address,address,uint256) but does NOT implement transfer(address,address,uint256), calling C.transfer(...) always succeeds (reference calls transferFrom), whereas the mutant that calls transfer(...) will fail when the callee lacks transfer(address,address,uint256).
change_summary: Change the required calldata selector to call transfer(address,address,uint256) instead of transferFrom, altering which external function on caddress is invoked.
